answer: We model trust propagation via personalized EigenTrust over a transition matrix, where each honest vertex acts as a baseline. To isolate the sable regions of adversarial behavior, a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function imposes a computational staking cost, rendering any Sybil haven unprofitable. By binding this delay to a slashing penalty, the expected utility of spanning multi-identity graphs becomes strictly negative, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium across all honest validators.
